description: Checks whether a single EVM address (0x...) is SAFE, DANGER, or UNKNOWN_UNVERIFIED_RPC across five chains (chainId: 8453 Base default, 42161 Arbitrum, 10 Optimism, 137 Polygon, 1 Ethereum; unknown IDs fall back to 8453). Strictly read-only, returning only a binary status and PROCEED/ABORT/CAUTION action with zero forensic leakage. Costs $0.01 USDC flat on Base via x402 v2; unpaid calls return isError: true with the payment challenge. Best for <=$0.05 bot budgets; escalate to ingravity_scanTokenRugpullAndHoneypot for tokens or ingravity_inspectEvmTransactionFirewall before signing calldata.

chainId.description: Target EVM chain ID: 8453 (Base), 42161 (Arbitrum), 10 (Optimism), 137 (Polygon), or 1 (Ethereum). Unsupported values fall back to 8453.
